summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, attaching a June 29 news release. The company announced a temporary slowdown at its Ying and GC mining operations in China due to new nationwide safety measures imposed after a coal mine accident. The company identified non-compliances with the Six Major Safety Systems and engaged vendors to complete upgrades costing approximately $5.5 million, plus an additional $6 million for equipment upgrades, expected to take about 50 days. Government procedures allow phased resumption after inspection. No deal terms. This is an operational update, not a special situation.
